messages:
Maya (Docs): Hey team — opened docs PR for the new SDK embedding snippet and migration notes. Need a merge slot before the v1.4 doc cutoff on Fri 18:00 UTC. PR: https://git/repo/pulls/4215

Jordan (Eng): Ack. Which parts are risky if we merge early? Any feature flags the docs reference?

Maya (Docs): It references the new-embed-pipeline behavior. We added a short migration note and an example. We marked the example as v1.4 only. Want to avoid the public docs showing it before the flag is enabled.

Alex (Product): Recommend gating the live page behind the feature flag mention + a short note at top: "This feature is behind new-embed-pipeline; rollout scheduled for next ship." That prevents users from trying it prematurely.

Priya (Release): Cutoff is Fri 18:00 UTC. After that, only emergency doc fixes. If this must land earlier, we need approvals + passing docs preview CI. Otherwise it goes after the branch cut.

Maya (Docs): CI preview is currently failing on an embed snippet linting error. Jordan, can you take a look? CI-bot shows: "docs-preview: failed (lint)"

CI-bot: docs-preview pipeline started for PR #4215 — build id bld-8702

Jordan (Eng): On it. I see the snippet uses an older param name. Quick fix is to update example to the new client API.

Maya (Docs): Here's the old snippet in the PR that fails lint:```js
// old embed call
const out = await client.embed({text: 'hello'});
```

Jordan (Eng): Replace with this (works with latest SDK and satisfies lint):```js
// updated embed call for SDK v1.4
const out = await client.embeddings.create({input: 'hello'});
console.log(out.data[0].embedding.length);
```

Maya (Docs): Pushed a patch with that change. Thanks.

CI-bot: docs-preview build bld-8702 — lint passed, build complete. Preview: https://docs-preview/internal/4215

Alex (Product): Quick review: the migration note looks good. Can we also add a one-line compatibility table showing which SDK versions support the new param? People often miss the version requirement.

Maya (Docs): Added a compatibility row to front matter: `supported_sdk: ["1.4+"]` and a tiny table in the migration section.

Priya (Release): Two more asks before I sign-off for pre-cutoff merge: 1) Mark PR as "merge-on-slot" and add to release calendar, 2) confirm release-notes entry status (should be blank or internal-only for now).

Maya (Docs): Done — added label `merge-on-slot`, calendar event created for Thu 12:00 UTC merge slot. Release-notes set to internal-only.

Jordan (Eng): LGTM from eng side. Approving now.

Alex (Product): Approving. Added :eyes: and small nit (inline wording) — Maya will fix.

Maya (Docs): Fixed wording nit. All approvals in PR thread.

Priya (Release): Ok — since CI preview passed and approvals are present, we can merge in Thu 12:00 UTC slot. Reminder: if the feature flag rollout slips, we'll hold the live publish and instead merge behind the "unpublished" flag so site won't show it until enabled.

Jordan (Eng): If we need to merge earlier, we can use the site "draft:" frontmatter to keep page hidden. But prefer slot approach.

Maya (Docs): Sounds good. I'll queue the merge for Thu 12:00 UTC and monitor the feature flag progress. Will post here when merged. :thumbsup:

CI-bot: PR #4215 status: approvals=3, checks=passed, labels=[merge-on-slot]. Ready for scheduled merge.

Maya (Docs): Update — merged at 2024-11-14T12:00:05Z. Will follow up if any issues from preview or user reports.

Alex (Product): Thanks all.

Priya (Release): Marking this as done on the release checklist.

Jordan (Eng): Nice and clean.

Maya (Docs): Closing thread."
